author: DCBu
content: Plan: Add KickoffRuntime enum to types.rs with Claude/Antigravity/Both variants and parse_kickoff_runtime(). Add runtime field to KickoffOpts. Add build_agy_command() to launch.rs (agy -m <model> -p 'prompt' --dangerously-skip-permissions). Update preflight_check() to also check 'agy' binary when runtime includes antigravity. Update launch_local() to dispatch to build_agy_command() or build_agent_command() based on runtime. Wire --runtime flag through KickoffCommands::Run and Launch in main.rs and through dispatch in mod.rs. Update all KickoffOpts constructors in tests.rs and mod.rs to include runtime field. Add new tests for build_agy_command() and parse_kickoff_runtime().
